newsitem.title: USA: Cyclone moving east off Queensland, weakening.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone moving east off Queensland, weakening.

text.p: Tropical Cyclone Justin, off Eastern Australia, has moved eastward during the past 24 hours, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Thursday.
The cyclone, with 45 mph winds, is in the Coral Sea near 14.8s/153.4e, moving east at nine mph, WSC said.

The system should slowly weaken as it moves east and then back west during the next 48-72 hours. It continues to threaten shipping in the Coral Sea and coastal areas of northeast Queensland will continue to see rough surf and possible beach erosion.
